mentions.name: Pound
mentions.description: A drink pacing app that helps people slow and track their drinking pace, addressing situations like an out-of-whack internal clock after taste changes from GLP-1 weight loss and easily crushable hard seltzers that make drinking fast too easy.
mentions.problem: After losing weight on GLP-1s and shifting from IPAs to cocktails, internal drinking-pace cues feel out of whack, and highly drinkable hard seltzers make it far too easy to drink fast.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on a drink pacing app: https://www.trypound.app/
mentions.author: mikesickler
